IGUI_SH_Hint_Ready: Call it in to start the inbound clock.
IGUI_SH_Hint_Aiming: Click map: mark / RMB, ESC: cancel
IGUI_SH_Hint_Busy: Wait for the mission in progress.
IGUI_SH_NoSignal: NO SIGNAL // TURN THE RADIO ON
IGUI_SH_Info1_b2: Click a point on the sensor map, or look at one in first person and click: %2 bombs fall within %1 tiles of it. One strike per sortie.
IGUI_SH_View2D: 3D VIEW OFF // SWITCH TO FIRST PERSON TO AIM
IGUI_SH_Info2_b2: The blasts draw infected from very far away. You are spared unless "protect the player" is off.
IGUI_SH_OptVoice_tt: Loudness of Aegis Control and the crews. 0 leaves only the subtitles.
IGUI_SH_OptSubtitles_tt: Shows the radio subtitle bar while the crews talk. Off: voices only. Drag the bar to move it.
IGUI_SH_OptEngine_tt: Loudness of the engines while the gunship orbits overhead. 0 turns them off.
IGUI_SH_OptKeyTerminal_tt: Opens the air support terminal straight from a two-way radio you carry; press again to close. While it is open: up/down picks an aircraft, right calls or fires, left recalls.
IGUI_SH_OptKeyFeed_tt: Turns the live picture on the terminal's sensor map on or off, like its SENSOR button.
IGUI_SH_AllOff: All air support is turned off in the sandbox settings
IGUI_SH_OptCallMode_tt: Standard: aircraft rearm on a cooldown. Killstreak: zombies you kill yourself earn points, and each sortie costs points. Applies only when the sandbox call mode is set to Player's choice.
IGUI_SH_PvPLock: An Apache has you in its sights! Run or get indoors
IGUI_SH_PvPRestart: The server restarted: your air support sortie has ended
IGUI_SH_Tip_GunAim: Aim the 40mm yourself, on top of its own fire: each click in the game view fires a short burst there (from the same ammunition). Right-click or Escape to stop.
IGUI_SH_OptPtsHalo_tt: Killstreak mode only. Points you earn appear over your character, like experience: kills are added up for a second at a time. Calls and refunds show too.
IGUI_SH_OptRotor_tt: Loudness of the Apache's rotor while it escorts you, and of the Wraith Team's transport. 0 turns them off. The AC-130 engine options do not change it.
IGUI_SH_OptFeed: Live sensor picture on the terminal map
IGUI_SH_OptFeed_tt: While the AC-130, the Apache or the B-2 is on station, the terminal's map shows its thermal picture: infected as white squares, friendly people as green squares, you as a diamond, the 40mm's target in corner brackets. The mouse wheel zooms it.
IGUI_SH_OptInbound_tt: Real seconds from the call until the aircraft arrives. Applies from the next call.
IGUI_SH_OptStation_tt: Real minutes the aircraft stays after it arrives (for the B-2: the time you have to mark its target), the same in every save whatever its day length. The clock stops while the game is paused. Applies from the next call.
IGUI_SH_OptRearm_tt: Real minutes after the aircraft leaves until it can be called again, the same in every save whatever its day length. 0 means right away.
IGUI_SH_OptInterval_tt: Average seconds between bursts. If the target falls during a burst, the rest of the burst goes to the next one.
IGUI_SH_OptRange_tt: Infected within this distance of the player are targeted.
IGUI_SH_OptAmmo_tt: 40mm rounds the gunship brings on each call.
IGUI_SH_OptHeAmmo_tt: 105mm shells the gunship brings on each call.
IGUI_SH_OptHeRounds_tt: Shells fired at each marked point: the first lands on the mark, the rest around it. A mark with fewer shells left fires what is left.
IGUI_SH_OptArea_tt: Bombs are spread evenly within this distance of the marked center. Each bomb kills within 9 tiles and can reach 14.
IGUI_SH_OptBombs_tt: Heavy bombs dropped in one strike. Fewer, bigger blasts than before; raise it with the radius to avoid gaps.
IGUI_SH_OptCraters_tt: 105mm rounds and B-2 bombs leave the ground where they land burnt black, with the grass and bushes gone. Outdoors only; buildings, trees and water are left alone. The tactical nuke (single player) levels everything within 50 tiles, buildings included. This is a lasting change to the map, saved with your game.
IGUI_SH_OptFx_tt: High: fireball, dust, smoke, sparks and a flash of real light. Medium: less smoke and sparks, light only for the big blasts. Low: fireball and dust only, no light (lightest on the frame rate).
IGUI_SH_OptIndoor_tt: When ticked, blasts also kill infected inside buildings and the 105mm may be aimed under a roof. When off, a roof shelters what is under it.
IGUI_SH_OptProtect_tt: When ticked, your own fire never hurts you. When off, standing too close to a blast hurts or kills you (40mm splash included).
IGUI_SH_OptImpactShake_tt: How hard your view shakes when a 105mm round or a B-2 bomb lands near you: strongest close in, fading with distance (105mm within about 45 tiles, B-2 bombs about 70). 0 turns it off. Not in the Vanilla edition.
IGUI_SH_Tip_MarkMap: Pick the point on the sensor map. The terminal stays open.
IGUI_SH_Tip_MarkEyes: The terminal folds away; point at the target in the game view and click. Right-click or ESC cancels.
IGUI_SH_SPOnly: This edition is single player only: online, use the Vanilla edition
IGUI_SH_OptVisual_tt: Draws the AC-130 circling overhead and the Apache flying its escort in Viewpoint's 3D view, with muzzle flashes at each AC-130 shot. It needs ZombieBuddy to load its Java part; without it this does nothing and the rest of the mod works as usual.
IGUI_SH_OptVisAlt_tt: How high the AC-130 flies, in render units. Only the picture: it does not change the fire.
IGUI_SH_OptVisRadius_tt: How wide a circle the AC-130 flies around you. Only the picture.
IGUI_SH_OptVisSize_tt: Scale of the AC-130 model. Only the picture.
IGUI_SH_OptVisApacheAlt_tt: How high the Apache flies above your floor, in render units (one storey is about 2.4). Only the picture: it does not change the fire.
IGUI_SH_OptVisApacheSize_tt: Scale of the Apache model. Only the picture.
IGUI_SH_Info1_ac130: The 40mm bursts at the nearest infected around you on its own (hold or resume it here). For the 105mm, mark a point on the sensor map or eyes-on: its rounds land around it (how many per mark: Mod Options).
IGUI_SH_Info2_ac130: One gunship carries both: one call, one time on station, one return. The 40mm only targets outdoors on your floor; the 105mm needs open ground unless indoor hits are on. The blasts draw the infected.
IGUI_SH_Info1_apache: Circles close and bursts 30mm at the infected nearest you. A big enough group gets a salvo of rockets, never one you stand near. Mark a point and it fires an illumination rocket that lights it up.
IGUI_SH_Info2_apache: Outdoors on your floor only. Hold or resume fire from the terminal. It leaves when its time is up or both guns are empty.
IGUI_SH_Hint_Apache: Hunting the infected around you; rockets for big groups.
IGUI_SH_OptCannonAmmo_tt: 30mm rounds the Apache brings on each call; it fires them in short bursts.
IGUI_SH_OptRockets_tt: Hydra rockets carried. They go in salvos into a big group of infected at least 10 tiles from you. 0 leaves them at home.
IGUI_SH_OptSalvo_tt: How many rockets one salvo fires at a group.
IGUI_SH_OptRocketEvery_tt: The shortest wait from one rocket salvo to the next.
IGUI_SH_OptRocketMin_tt: How many infected must stand together (within 4 tiles) before rockets are fired at them.
IGUI_SH_OptFlares_tt: Flares carried a sortie, fired on a point you mark on the terminal (map or eyes-on). Each lights the area for a while; no blast, and it draws no infected. 0 leaves them at home and hides the mark buttons.
IGUI_SH_OptFlareSec_tt: How long one flare lights the area.
IGUI_SH_OptFlareRadius_tt: How far around the marked point the flare lights. A bigger light makes the game relight more squares when it comes on and goes out.
IGUI_SH_OptVisB2Alt_tt: Height above the marked target floor. Visual only; bomb damage and timing are unchanged.
IGUI_SH_OptVisB2Size_tt: Visual scale of the B-2 flyover. Does not change the bombing area.
IGUI_SH_OptReset_tt: Puts every Skyhammer Air Support option on this page back to its default value, keys included. Takes effect at once.
IGUI_SH_OptShadows_tt: In the normal (isometric) view, the Apache, AC-130 and B-2 cast their shadow on the ground as they pass. Outdoors only; at night only over lit ground (street lamps, lit windows, a flashlight). Not drawn in Viewpoint's 3D view, where the aircraft themselves are seen.
IGUI_SH_OptApacheModel_tt: In the normal (isometric) view, the Apache is drawn as a 3D model above its shadow. Off: the shadow alone, as before. Single player only.
IGUI_SH_OptTracker_tt: While the air support unlock quest is under way, its current step and hint stay in a corner of the screen.
IGUI_SH_OptTrackerCorner_tt: The corner of the screen the quest tracker sits in.
IGUI_SH_Q_NoQuest: In this game air support answers any two-way radio.
IGUI_SH_Q_Hint_broadcast: Leave a radio on for a while. Someone may still be out there.
IGUI_SH_Q_Hint_manual: Aegis's manuals may still lie wherever the soldiers worked.
IGUI_SH_Q_Hint_relay: A dish on a wall to reach the sky, a military ham radio close by (set up, on the floor or in a container), and a generator to keep them alive.
IGUI_SH_Q_Hint_radio: Build the radio the manual describes, or find one.
IGUI_SH_Q_Hint_contact: Call Aegis on the air support radio while the relay has power.
IGUI_SH_Q_BlockNoRelay: NO RELAY // BRING AN AEGIS RELAY ONLINE
IGUI_SH_Q_FailSite: Aegis can't use a relay here
IGUI_SH_Q_FailRadio: Needs a %1 within 6 squares of the dish (one floor up or down is fine): set up, on the floor or in a container
IGUI_SH_Info1_a10: One A-10 carries both its GAU-8 gun and napalm. Mark one point with GUN RUN or NAPALM, on the sensor map or eyes-on: the pilot flies a 40-tile line through it, picking the direction that catches the most infected and never one that passes near you.
IGUI_SH_Info2_a10: Between runs it comes around for about 20 s: a new mark is the next run, with the weapon of the button you used. Without one, only a gun run flies the same line back; napalm is never dropped without a mark. It leaves when both weapons are spent or its time is up. Roofs stop the rounds unless indoor hits are on; the gun draws the infected.
IGUI_SH_Info1_a10_gun: One A-10 flies gun runs with its GAU-8. Mark one point with GUN RUN, on the sensor map or eyes-on: the pilot flies a 40-tile line through it, picking the direction that catches the most infected and never one that passes near you.
IGUI_SH_Info2_a10_gun: Between runs it comes around for about 20 s: a new mark is the next run. Without one, it flies the same line back. It leaves when its gun runs are spent or its time is up. Roofs stop the rounds unless indoor hits are on; the gun draws the infected.
IGUI_SH_Hint_A10Mark_gun: Mark a point with GUN RUN.
IGUI_SH_Hint_A10Last: Last run under way. The A-10 heads home after it.
IGUI_SH_OptA10: Valkyrie Two-Six // A-10 gun runs (GAU-8) and napalm
IGUI_SH_OptPasses_tt: How many strafing runs the A-10 flies on one call. It comes around for about 20 seconds between runs and goes home when its gun runs and napalm runs are all flown.
IGUI_SH_OptNapalmRuns_tt: How many napalm runs the A-10 carries on one call, besides its gun runs. Each one needs its own NAPALM mark on the terminal; napalm is never dropped again without one. 0: gun runs only.
IGUI_SH_OptVisA10Alt_tt: Height of the A-10 above the marked floor as it starts its dive. Visual only; the run itself is unchanged.
IGUI_SH_OptVisA10Size_tt: Visual scale of the A-10. Does not change the run itself.
IGUI_SH_Hint_A10Mark: Mark a point with GUN RUN or NAPALM.
IGUI_SH_Hint_A10Next: Coming around. Mark the next run, or it flies the line back.
IGUI_SH_Hint_A10NextMark: Coming around. Mark the next run.
IGUI_SH_Tip_Loadout: Choose what the B-2 carries before you call it: carpet bombs or the tactical nuke. It cannot be changed once the call is made.
IGUI_SH_Loadout_Why_NukeOffServer: The tactical nuke is switched off on this server.
IGUI_SH_Loadout_Why_NukeOffOption: The tactical nuke is switched off in Mod Options.
IGUI_SH_Loadout_Why_NukeCooldown: The tactical nuke is not ready: %1 left.
IGUI_SH_Info1_a10_napalm: NAPALM: four canisters come down along the line. Each leaves a strip of fire that burns for the time set in Mod Options, and the infected in it catch fire and go down within a few seconds. How many napalm runs a sortie carries is set in Mod Options.
IGUI_SH_Info1_b2_nuke: Mark ground zero on the sensor map or eyes-on, 60 to 300 tiles from you (past 145 with Protect the player off). The bomb goes off 15 seconds later: every infected within 140 tiles dies (the 50-tile fireball leaves no body), and the noise draws the infected from 300 tiles. With Strikes leave craters on, everything within 50 tiles is levelled (single player). One per sortie; the B-2 then takes its longer nuke rearm (2 hours, Mod Options; or 600 points).
IGUI_SH_OptNukeEnabled_tt: Lets the B-2 carry a tactical nuke, picked with the loadout button on its terminal tab. Online the server's sandbox must allow it as well. Off: the nuke cannot be picked.
IGUI_SH_OptNukeVisSize_tt: How big the mushroom cloud is drawn in the 3D view (0.5 to 1.5). It changes only the picture, never the blast. Not in the Vanilla edition.
IGUI_SH_OptNukeEmp_tt: Single player. When ticked, the nuke also switches off every running generator and stops every running vehicle engine within 300 tiles of ground zero (those the game has loaded). Off: they are left alone.
IGUI_SH_OptNapalmBurn_tt: How long each napalm fire burns, in seconds. The infected inside catch fire and go down within a few seconds; so do you, if Protect the player is off.
IGUI_SH_OptNapalmRealFire_tt: Single player. When ticked, napalm also lights the game's real fire along its strips on open ground. WARNING: real fire spreads. It can reach buildings, burn them down and kill you, and it cannot be put out on command. Off: the napalm fire is only an effect and spreads to nothing.
IGUI_SH_Info2_a10_napalm: The four canisters each cover a quarter of the line with a strip of fire about 8 tiles wide, and the ground under them is burnt black. Anything alive on your floor inside a strip catches fire, indoors too; a roof does not shelter it. The fire stays only where it fell, unless the real fire option is on.
IGUI_SH_OptNukeRearm_tt: How long the B-2 rearms after a sortie that dropped the tactical nuke, in real minutes. After its bombs it uses the rearm above. Online the server's sandbox sets it.
IGUI_SH_Tip_LoadoutNuke: After the tactical nuke the B-2 rearms for %1.
IGUI_SH_Tip_LoadoutConv: After the carpet bombs the B-2 rearms for %1.
IGUI_SH_L_GunCall: Banshee Two-One, Aegis. Troops in contact. Survivor requests fire support, grid follows.
IGUI_SH_L_GunCallAck: Aegis, Banshee Two-One. Copy all. Pushing to your grid.
IGUI_SH_L_GunOnStation: Banshee Two-One, established in the orbit. TV has capture. Eyes on the survivor.
IGUI_SH_L_GunReady: Forty mike-mike's hot. Cleared to engage.
IGUI_SH_L_GunEngage: Movers closing on the survivor. Engaging.
IGUI_SH_L_GunHold: Banshee, Aegis. Cease fire, cease fire.
IGUI_SH_L_GunResumeAck: Cleared hot. Back on the gun.
IGUI_SH_L_HeMark: Send the one-oh-five your point. Right-click or Escape to cancel.
IGUI_SH_L_GunAimMark: Forty's yours. Mark it, three rounds a click.
IGUI_SH_L_HeDone: Rounds complete. Banshee's ready for the next mark.
IGUI_SH_L_Indoor: Rounds won't go through a roof. Pick an open spot.
IGUI_SH_L_HeBusy: Banshee's still on the last target. Stand by.
IGUI_SH_L_B2Call: Titan Zero-One, Aegis. Survivor requests a heavy strike. Target grid follows.
IGUI_SH_L_B2CallAck: Aegis, Titan Zero-One. Copy all. Climbing to release altitude.
IGUI_SH_L_B2OnStation: Titan Zero-One, overhead. Weapons armed. Send the target.
IGUI_SH_L_B2Mark: Send the center of the strike box. Right-click or Escape to cancel.
IGUI_SH_L_B2Danger: Danger close! You're inside the strike box! Get down, get down!
IGUI_SH_L_B2Done: Impacts observed. Good effects on target. Titan Zero-One, RTB.
IGUI_SH_L_B2Busy: Negative. Titan's already on the bomb run.
IGUI_SH_L_B2Rtb: Titan, Aegis. Abort, abort, abort. RTB.
IGUI_SH_L_Rearming: That aircraft is still rearming. Try again later.
IGUI_SH_L_PtsApache: Hellhound is cleared for tasking. Call it in when ready.
IGUI_SH_L_PtsGun: Banshee is cleared for tasking. Call it in when ready.
IGUI_SH_L_PtsB2: Titan is cleared for a strike. Call it in when ready.
IGUI_SH_L_NotReady: That aircraft is not on station yet.
IGUI_SH_L_Need3D: I can't see your mark. Switch to first person and look at the target.
IGUI_SH_L_TooFar: That grid is outside our picture. Pick a closer point.
IGUI_SH_L_ApacheCall: Hellhound One-One, Aegis. Survivor needs a gun escort. Grid follows.
IGUI_SH_L_ApacheCallAck: Aegis, Hellhound One-One. Copy. Coming in low and fast.
IGUI_SH_L_ApacheOnStation: Hellhound on station. Tally the survivor. Guns hot.
IGUI_SH_L_ApacheEngage: Infected closing on the survivor. Engaging, thirty mike-mike.
IGUI_SH_L_ApacheRockets: Big group in the open. Rockets, rockets.
IGUI_SH_L_ApacheHold: Hellhound, Aegis. Cease fire, cease fire.
IGUI_SH_L_ApacheResumeAck: Cleared hot. Back on the guns.
IGUI_SH_L_FlareMark: Send the point to illuminate. Right-click or Escape to cancel.
IGUI_SH_L_ApacheDry: Hellhound's Winchester. Nothing left to shoot.
IGUI_SH_L_ApacheTakingFire: Hellhound taking fire! Taking fire! Breaking left!
IGUI_SH_L_ApacheShotDown: Hellhound's hit! Hit hard! Breaking off, we're going home!
IGUI_SH_L_ApacheGoodKillGroup: Good hits, good hits. That group is done.
IGUI_SH_L_GunContactGroup: Big group moving in. Stand by, lining up the forty.
IGUI_SH_L_GunPilotSteady: Pilot copies. Holding her steady. Gunner, you're clear.
IGUI_SH_L_GunOrbitWatch: Banshee Two-One, still in the orbit. We've got you covered.
IGUI_SH_L_GunSensorTrack: Movement near your position. No clean shot yet.
IGUI_SH_L_GunKeepScanning: More movement there. Hang on, finding the next one.
IGUI_SH_L_GunQuietSector: Nothing moving in the open. Eyes on.
IGUI_SH_L_GunAngelFlares: Flares away. Don't mind the fireworks.
IGUI_SH_L_GunOneMinute: One minute to bingo. Send your last targets.
IGUI_SH_L_GunBreakOrbit: Banshee Two-One, breaking orbit. Good hunting down there.
IGUI_SH_L_GunGoodKillGroup: Good shots. They are all down.
IGUI_SH_L_QBroadcast1: This is Aegis Control, broadcasting in the blind. Any survivor on this channel, we cannot hear you.
IGUI_SH_L_QBroadcast2: Your handsets do not reach this far. Put up a relay: a dish, a military ham radio, and power.
IGUI_SH_L_QBroadcast3: Our signal manuals went out with the military. Find one, build an air support radio, and call us. Aegis, out.
IGUI_SH_L_QRelayUp: Relay signal confirmed. Aegis Control has your grid.
IGUI_SH_L_QRelayDark: Aegis to survivor, we have lost your relay. Check its power.
IGUI_SH_L_QRelayLost: Your relay is gone from the net. Set up a new one to reach us.
IGUI_SH_L_QContact1: Survivor, Aegis Control. Signal authenticated. Welcome to the net.
IGUI_SH_L_QContact2: Hellhound One-One, up on your freq. Standing by.
IGUI_SH_L_QContact3: Banshee Two-One. The guns are yours when you need them.
IGUI_SH_L_QContact4: Titan Zero-One, on call for the heavy work.
IGUI_SH_L_QContact5: All units are on your channel. Call when you need us. Aegis, out.
IGUI_SH_L_A10Call: Valkyrie Two-Six, Aegis. Survivor requests a gun run. Grid follows.
IGUI_SH_L_A10CallAck: Aegis, Valkyrie Two-Six. Copy. The Hog's inbound.
IGUI_SH_L_A10OnStation: Valkyrie Two-Six on station. Gun's hot. Send your target.
IGUI_SH_L_A10Mark: Send your target. Valkyrie picks the run-in. Right-click or Escape to cancel.
IGUI_SH_L_A10Off: Off target. Coming around for another pass.
IGUI_SH_L_A10Copy: Copy new mark. Next pass is on it.
IGUI_SH_L_A10ReAttack: No new mark. Re-attack, reversing in.
IGUI_SH_L_A10DangerClose: Negative, danger close. No safe run-in from there. Mark it farther from you.
IGUI_SH_L_A10Hold: You're on my run line. Holding off. Give me a new mark.
IGUI_SH_L_A10Winchester: Valkyrie Two-Six, Winchester. Off station, RTB.
IGUI_SH_L_A10Standby: Valkyrie Two-Six, holding. Send the next mark.
IGUI_SH_L_PtsA10: Valkyrie is cleared for tasking. Call it in when ready.
IGUI_SH_L_NukeMark: Designate ground zero. Minimum safe distance six-zero. Right-click or Escape to cancel.
IGUI_SH_L_NukeAsk: Titan, Aegis. Nuclear release authorized. Authenticate.
IGUI_SH_L_NukeAuth: Aegis, Titan. Authenticated. Nuclear weapon armed.
IGUI_SH_L_NukeDone: Nuclear detonation confirmed. Titan Zero-One egressing, RTB.
IGUI_SH_L_NukeDanger: Negative, danger close. You are inside the blast. Mark farther out.
IGUI_SH_L_NukeCooldown: Negative. No release authority at this time.
IGUI_SH_L_NukeOffOption: Negative. Nuclear release is not authorized. It is off in your Mod Options.
IGUI_SH_L_NukeOffServer: Negative. Nuclear release is not authorized on this server.
IGUI_SH_L_NukeTooFar: Negative. Ground zero is out of range. Mark closer.
IGUI_SH_L_NukeNoSortie: Negative. No Titan sortie on record. Call the B-2 first.
IGUI_SH_L_RadAfterBlast: All stations, Aegis. Fallout round ground zero. Stay clear, or mask up.
IGUI_SH_L_RadEnter: Survivor, Aegis. You're in the fallout. Mask up or get out.
IGUI_SH_L_RadClear: Aegis. The fallout has cleared. Ground zero is safe.
IGUI_SH_L_NapalmAway: Napalm away. Four cans on the deck.
